rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the act or process of eggs hatching.

example.english: The hatching process for this batch of chicken eggs went smoothly.
example.traditional: 呢批雞蛋嘅孵化過程幾順利。
example.jyutping: ne1 pai1 gai1 daan2 ge3 fu1 faa3 gwo3 cing4 gei2 seon6 lei6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the young animal emerging from its shell rather than the overall incubation process.

example.english: The baby turtles crawled to the sea as soon as they finished hatching.
example.traditional: 啲小龜一出殼就爬去海邊。
example.jyutping: di1 siu2 gwai1 jat1 ceot1 hok3 zau6 paa4 heoi3 hoi2 bin1

rows.note: Use this for the brood as one group, especially when it is understood as a nest or clutch of hatchlings.

example.english: That brood of chicks in the tree all finished hatching on the same day.
example.traditional: 樹上嗰一窩雀仔係同一日出殼㗎。
example.jyutping: syu6 soeng6 go2 jat1 wo1 zoek3 zai2 hai6 tung4 jat1 jat6 ceot1 hok3 gaa3
